clips.title: The story
paras: In Brill, the Forsaken leadership has posted a death bounty for Maggot Eye. The notorious gnoll robs nearby graveyards and farms, supplying bodies to the Lich King's Scourge. Executor Zygand demands proof of the kill to secure the lands around Garren's Haunt.

In Tirisfal Glades, the dead do not rest in peace. Maggot Eye faces a severe death sentence for aiding the Lich King. Gnolls are usually seen as savage brutes driven by hunger, but Maggot Eye digs up corpses and gathers remains to strengthen the Scourge army.

The Forsaken fight to break free of the Lich King's control, so feeding their dead kin to the Scourge is among the gravest offenses. Executor Zygand oversees local military enforcement in Brill and ordered the bounty to end the grave robberies near Garren's Haunt. To claim the prize, you need Maggot Eye's paw as proof that the beast can trouble Tirisfal no longer.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A foul beast, even by Gnoll standards, Maggot Eye has been sentenced to death for his crimes against The Forsaken. This despicable villain has been stealing corpses for use by the Lich King's army. Maggot Eye was last seen pillaging the lands near Garren's Haunt to the north of Brill.
The town of Brill hereby offers a reward to the capable soul who can carry out the execution. Show Executor Zygand the villain's paw once the deed is done.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Maggot Eye's dastardly acts have finally been avenged. Maybe your acts of valor will send a clear message to those who wish to bring harm to our people. On behalf of the town of Brill I thank you, friend.
